verdict.rationale: Ollama runs a local REST API server with local base URLs, and it documents OpenAI client compatibility, though only for "a subset of the OpenAI API". A community user confirms models can be hot-swapped without restarting the server, which supports serving any loaded model. Missing for 10: documentation of which OpenAI endpoints and parameters are covered, explicit server launch and configuration steps, and independent hands-on confirmation of OpenAI-client compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Connect OpenAI clients to Ollama. Ollama supports a subset of the OpenAI API
Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
Learn the local and cloud base URLs, then send a request with curl.
the ability to 'hotswap' models with different utility instead of restarting the server
